caption: The drawing depicts a wooden hand screw clamp composed of two vertical parallel wooden jaws, each with a slightly tapered top. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with a grainy texture, indicating the natural appearance of the material. Two cylindrical threaded rods, also brown, run horizontally through both jaws, securing them together. Each rod has a dark brown cylindrical handle on either end, used for tightening or loosening the clamp. The clamp is positioned at an angle so the front faces of the jaws and both handles are visible. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or features.
title: Carpenter's Clamp
